name: a0kit
description: A dependency-light (numpy-only) Python library implementing the calculational relations of the de Sitter-Unruh modified-inertia framework for the MOND acceleration scale a0. It computes the horizon-derived scale a0 = c H_Lambda / Z = c^2 sqrt(Lambda/32pi) (both the pure-dark-energy 'canonical' and total-density 'alt' footings), the Lambda<->a0 and rho_DE<->a0 inversions (Lambda = 32pi a0^2/c^4), the interpolation kernel nu(y)=sqrt(1+1/y) (the functional form of Milgrom 1999), the a0-line identity g_obs^2 - g_bar^2 = a0 g_bar and its single-point inverse, the redshift law a0(z)/a0(0) = sqrt(rho_DE(z)/rho_DE,0) under a CPL dark-energy history, and the deep-MOND baryonic Tully-Fisher flat velocity. Scope note: the library COMPUTES the framework's relations; it does not derive them. The value of a0, the coefficient Z = sqrt(32pi/3), and the sign of the inertial correction are posited, not derived; the interpolation kernel is Milgrom's 1999 functional form. Both a0 footings are provided. Used to produce and verify the numerical results of the framework's papers.
